/llm-privacy/openai.title: OpenAI API Data Retention & ZDR in 2026 | Meetily

children.text: OpenAI API data retention and zero data retention (ZDR)

OpenAI does not train on API data by default, and keeps API inputs and outputs for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring. Zero data retention (ZDR) removes that 30-day window for eligible customers on approved endpoints. It is not self-serve. Since 22 September 2026, OpenAI has been rolling out Private Safety Processing to API customers in phases. It runs automated safety checks across related requests so OpenAI can keep offering ZDR, and OpenAI staff never see your content. Here is who qualifies, what OpenAI still keeps, and how to use OpenAI in Meetily with your own key.
Trains on API customer data by default

OpenAI's enterprise privacy page commits that data submitted through the OpenAI API, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Team is not used to train OpenAI's models. The consumer ChatGPT free and Plus tiers default differently and are out of scope for this page.

When Meetily users select OpenAI as their summary provider via BYOK, the request hits api.openai.com under your API key and your account's contract. The defaults on this page apply unless you have a separate enterprise arrangement.

OpenAI's documented default for API inputs and outputs is short-term retention for abuse monitoring (up to 30 days as published by OpenAI), after which the data is deleted unless legal obligations require longer retention. Specific endpoints such as fine-tuning, Assistants, and Stored Completions have their own retention semantics that you opt into when you use those features.

For exact retention windows, consult OpenAI's enterprise privacy documentation and your Business Associate Agreement (if applicable). Reviewing those before deployment is recommended for regulated workloads.

OpenAI offers zero data retention for eligible customers on supported endpoints. With ZDR, prompts and outputs are not stored after the request completes, and the store parameter is always treated as false even if a request sets it to true. Supported endpoints include /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/embeddings, /v1/audio/transcriptions, /v1/audio/translations, /v1/moderations, and others enumerated in OpenAI's data-controls documentation. ZDR is an approved, opt-in control rather than a self-serve toggle: eligibility and the current endpoint list are published by OpenAI, and your account team must enable it at the organization or project level.

Even under ZDR, OpenAI's documentation notes that logs may be retained where longer retention is required by law or is reasonably necessary to protect its services or any third party from harm. "Zero retention" is therefore not absolute in every legal sense, though it removes the routine 30-day abuse-monitoring window.

On 19 August 2026 OpenAI previewed Private Safety Processing, and on 22 September 2026 it began rolling it out to API customers in phases. OpenAI's existing ZDR-compatible safety checks look at one request at a time. Private Safety Processing looks across related requests, because some misuse only shows up as a pattern. OpenAI says the point is to keep offering ZDR as frontier models become more capable.

For ZDR deployments, customer content stays on infrastructure the customer controls. OpenAI is also developing an option that stores content on OpenAI infrastructure, encrypted with keys the customer holds and OpenAI does not.
When the system flags something, OpenAI receives a narrow signal: the type and severity of the activity. OpenAI staff do not get access to the prompts or responses, even when content is flagged.
The customer receives the full alert and can choose to share details with OpenAI, for example to appeal.

Eligibility for ZDR has not changed: it is still offered to eligible API customers, with OpenAI's approval. One exception applies even under ZDR: images flagged as potential child sexual abuse material (CSAM) are retained for manual review and reporting, because the law requires it.

A 2025 preservation order in the New York Times copyright litigation required OpenAI to retain output data going forward, overriding the normal deletion schedule. That order applied to consumer ChatGPT (Free, Plus, Pro, Team) and to API customers without a ZDR agreement; API customers with a ZDR agreement, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Edu were excluded. OpenAI has stated that the obligation to retain that going-forward content ended on 2025-09-26.

The case is ongoing. In early 2026 a court ordered OpenAI to produce a sample of de-identified consumer ChatGPT logs in discovery; that production concerns consumer logs, not API traffic covered by a ZDR agreement. For any regulated Meetily deployment, confirm the current posture against OpenAI's published statements, and prefer a ZDR agreement or a local summary provider where the routine deletion schedule must not be overridable.

Meetily routes OpenAI traffic through your own API key. Your account's contract terms apply. The transcript text is sent over TLS to api.openai.com for summarization, and the response is returned to Meetily and stored locally on your device. Audio is never transmitted to OpenAI at any point.

If you want stronger guarantees than the cloud default offers, switch your summary model to a local provider (Ollama). Meetily's transcription path is already local, so the local-summary path keeps the entire pipeline on-device.
The facts on this page were last checked on 2026-09-26 against sources 1 and 5, and on 2026-06-29 against the others. Confirm against the linked policies, which OpenAI may update at any time.

"Data controls in the OpenAI platform," OpenAI. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data (accessed 2026-09-26). States API data is not used to train or improve OpenAI models unless you opt in, documents the 30-day abuse-monitoring retention, the ZDR-eligible endpoint list, and the legal-retention caveat.

"Enterprise privacy at OpenAI," OpenAI. https://openai.com/enterprise-privacy/ (accessed 2026-06-29). No-training commitment for API, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Team, plus enterprise compliance posture.

"How we're responding to The New York Times' data demands in order to protect user privacy," OpenAI. https://openai.com/index/response-to-nyt-data-demands/ (accessed 2026-06-29). Scope of the preservation order, exclusion of ZDR API customers and enterprise tiers, and the 2025-09-26 end of the going-forward retention obligation.

"OpenAI Loses Privacy Gambit: 20 Million ChatGPT Logs Likely Headed to Copyright Plaintiffs," Jones Walker LLP / National Law Review, 2025. https://natlawreview.com/article/openai-loses-privacy-gambit-20-million-chatgpt-logs-likely-headed-copyright (accessed 2026-06-29). Corroborates the early-2026 discovery order for de-identified consumer ChatGPT logs.

"Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models," OpenAI, 19 August 2026, updated 22 September 2026. https://openai.com/index/offering-zero-data-retention-for-frontier-models/ (accessed 2026-09-26). Source for Private Safety Processing, its phased rollout to API customers, what OpenAI receives when content is flagged, and the CSAM exception under ZDR.
Last verified: September 26, 2026. Policy source: OpenAI policy
Does OpenAI train models on my API prompts and outputs?

No, not by default. OpenAI's enterprise privacy page commits that data submitted via the API, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Team is not used to train OpenAI's models. The consumer ChatGPT free and Plus tiers are governed by different settings; this page covers the API path.
How long does OpenAI retain my API prompts and outputs?

OpenAI's published default for API inputs and outputs is up to 30 days for abuse monitoring, after which they are deleted, unless legal obligations require longer retention. Specific endpoints (e.g., fine-tuning, Assistants) carry their own retention semantics described in OpenAI's documentation.
Is zero data retention (ZDR) available for the OpenAI API?

Yes, for eligible customers on supported endpoints. ZDR removes the 30-day default retention so prompts and outputs are not stored after the request completes; when ZDR is active the store parameter is always treated as false. Supported endpoints include /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/embeddings, /v1/audio/transcriptions, /v1/audio/translations, and others listed in OpenAI's data-controls documentation. ZDR is an approved, opt-in control: contact your OpenAI account team to enable it at the organization or project level. Note that even under ZDR, OpenAI may retain logs where longer retention is required by law or is reasonably necessary to protect its services or third parties from harm.
What is Private Safety Processing, and does it change ZDR?

It is an automated safety system OpenAI previewed on 19 August 2026 and began rolling out to API customers in phases on 22 September 2026. It looks for misuse patterns across related requests, not just one request at a time, so OpenAI can keep offering ZDR as models get more capable. For ZDR deployments, customer content stays on infrastructure the customer controls, and OpenAI receives only a narrow signal (the type and severity of a potential issue), not the prompts or responses. OpenAI staff do not get access to the content, even when it is flagged. Who can get ZDR has not changed: it is still for eligible customers, with OpenAI's approval.
Where is OpenAI API data stored geographically?

OpenAI processes API traffic primarily on US infrastructure. Data residency options (e.g., European data residency) are available for eligible enterprise contracts; consult OpenAI sales for the current geographic scope.
How do I request deletion of data OpenAI has retained?

For API accounts, OpenAI deletes data on the published retention schedule by default. For deletion of data outside the default schedule, submit a request through OpenAI's privacy contact channels per the privacy policy on openai.com.
Does the New York Times lawsuit against OpenAI affect my API data retention?

A 2025 court order in the New York Times copyright litigation required OpenAI to preserve output data going forward, overriding the normal deletion schedule for consumer ChatGPT (Free, Plus, Pro, Team) and API customers without a ZDR agreement. API customers with a Zero Data Retention agreement, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Edu were excluded from that preservation order. OpenAI has stated that its obligation to retain that going-forward content ended on 2025-09-26. The case continues, and in early 2026 a court ordered OpenAI to produce a sample of de-identified consumer ChatGPT logs; that discovery concerns consumer logs, not API traffic covered by ZDR. Confirm the current status against OpenAI's published statements before relying on this for a regulated workload.
Does OpenAI have SOC 2, HIPAA, or other compliance certifications?

OpenAI publishes its compliance posture on their Trust Portal. SOC 2 Type 2 is available; HIPAA BAAs are available for eligible enterprise customers on supported endpoints. Consult OpenAI sales for the current scope.
How does Meetily handle OpenAI when I pick it as my summary provider?

Meetily transcription runs 100% locally by default. When you select an OpenAI model as your summary provider via BYOK, Meetily routes transcript text (not audio) to api.openai.com using your own API key. The retention and training defaults on this page apply to your traffic, not Meetily's.
What if I want zero retention but my OpenAI account does not have ZDR enabled?

Two options: ask your OpenAI account team to enable ZDR on your workspace, or switch your Meetily summary model to a local provider like Ollama. Meetily's transcription path is unchanged on the local-summary route, so the entire pipeline runs on your device.
Use OpenAI with Meetily, on your terms

Meetily transcription stays 100% local by default. For summaries, bring your own OpenAI key (BYOK) so the data path matches the policy you just read - or pick a local model if you want zero retention by construction.

/llm-privacy/openrouter.title: OpenRouter ZDR: Does It Log or Train on Prompts? | Meetily

children.text: OpenRouter zero data retention (ZDR) and prompt logging

OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses unless you opt in to logging, and it only uses them to improve its product if you opt in (for a 1% discount). The provider it routes to still applies its own retention. To close that gap, turn on zero data retention (ZDR) for your account or per request, so only ZDR endpoints are used. ZDR does not cover plugins such as web search.
Trains on API customer data by default

OpenRouter is a routing layer that exposes one API and one billing relationship while forwarding requests to dozens of downstream model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Groq, and many open-weight hosts). This is convenient for model experimentation and cost management, but it changes the privacy model.
Every OpenRouter request crosses two administrative boundaries:
OpenRouter to the downstream provider you selected.

OpenRouter sees the prompt to route and log usage. The downstream provider receives the prompt to generate the response. The retention and training defaults that apply to your data are the union of both parties' policies.

OpenRouter itself does not train models, and by default it does not log your prompts or completions. Its data-collection documentation states that OpenRouter "does not store your prompts or responses" unless you explicitly opt in to prompt logging, which is off by default. What it retains by default is request metadata: the number of prompt and completion tokens, latency, the model used, and similar request-level information, "not the content of your prompts or responses."

Opting in to logging is the user's choice. The "Private Input & Output Logging" option keeps your prompts and responses visible only in your own logs, and OpenRouter states it does not access or use that data. A separate opt-in ("OpenRouter Use of Inputs/Outputs") trades a small usage discount for letting OpenRouter use your inputs and outputs to improve its products; leave it off if you do not want that.

Whether your prompt is used for training and how long it is retained at the model provider is governed by the downstream provider's policy, not OpenRouter's. OpenRouter also exposes account-level toggles to disallow routing to providers that train on user data, with separate settings for paid versus free models.

OpenRouter now offers Zero Data Retention as a setting, which is a change from the earlier per-provider-only picture. ZDR routes your request only to endpoints whose provider will not store your data, and providers with a ZDR policy cannot train on that data either. You can enforce ZDR at three levels:
Per model group, independently for five groups (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, SpaceXAI, and all other models), via settings or guardrails.
Per request, via the zdr parameter, which operates as an "OR" with your account-wide and guardrail settings.

ZDR covers provider routing for inference requests only. It does not apply to plugins and tools you enable, such as web search, which may be run by third parties with their own data retention policies.

The important nuance is that ZDR still depends on the downstream provider supporting it on the endpoint you call: the effective guarantee is the union of your OpenRouter setting and the selected provider's policy. For high-assurance no-retention workloads, enabling ZDR on OpenRouter plus verifying the chosen provider supports it gives the no-retention path; calling the provider directly removes one administrative boundary, and local Ollama removes the network entirely.

Meetily routes OpenRouter traffic through your own API key. Both OpenRouter's terms and the downstream provider's terms apply. The transcript text is sent over TLS to api.openrouter.ai, forwarded to the downstream provider you selected, and the response is returned to Meetily and stored locally on your device. Audio is never transmitted to OpenRouter at any point.
For production summary traffic with strict privacy requirements, calling the underlying provider directly (or running local Ollama) removes the OpenRouter administrative boundary entirely.
Last verified: September 26, 2026. Policy source: OpenRouter policy
Does OpenRouter train models on my prompts?

No, not by default. OpenRouter is a routing service and does not train foundation models. It offers an opt-in setting that lets it use your inputs and outputs to improve its product in exchange for a 1% discount; it is off by default. Prompts are forwarded to the downstream provider you select, and that provider's training and retention defaults apply to the request body.

Not by default. OpenRouter's documentation states it does not store your prompts or responses unless you opt in to prompt logging, which is off by default. By default it retains only request metadata (token counts, latency, model used, timestamps), not the content of prompts or responses. The downstream provider you route to applies its own retention separately.
Is zero data retention available for OpenRouter?

Yes. OpenRouter now offers Zero Data Retention controls that route only to endpoints with a ZDR policy. You can enforce ZDR account-wide, per model group, or per request via the `zdr` parameter. Because ZDR depends on the downstream provider supporting it on the endpoint you call, the effective guarantee is the union of your OpenRouter setting and the selected provider's policy. ZDR applies only to routing for inference requests: plugins and tools you enable, such as web search, may be run by third parties with their own retention policies.
How does the routing layer affect my data path?

An OpenRouter call is two hops: your client to OpenRouter, then OpenRouter to the downstream provider. OpenRouter sees the prompt to route and log usage. The downstream provider receives the prompt to generate the response. Your data crosses one additional administrative boundary versus calling the provider directly.
Where is OpenRouter data stored geographically?

OpenRouter operates primarily on US infrastructure. Downstream provider geography depends on which provider and endpoint you select. For EU data-residency requirements, calling EU-resident providers (Mistral, Azure OpenAI EU regions) directly is usually a cleaner data path than routing through OpenRouter.
How do I delete data OpenRouter has retained?
Account deletion is available via email request per OpenRouter's privacy policy. Downstream-provider data deletion is the responsibility of the user under that provider's policy.
How does Meetily handle OpenRouter when I pick it as my summary provider?

Meetily transcription runs 100% locally by default. When you select an OpenRouter-routed model as your summary provider via BYOK, Meetily routes transcript text (not audio) to api.openrouter.ai using your own key. OpenRouter forwards the request to the downstream provider you selected. Both administrative boundaries apply.
When does it make sense to use OpenRouter with Meetily versus a direct provider?

OpenRouter is useful for testing multiple models behind one API and for cost-routing across providers. For production summary traffic with strict privacy requirements, calling the underlying provider directly removes one administrative boundary and one set of terms to audit. For zero retention by construction, use local Ollama and keep the entire pipeline on-device.
Use OpenRouter with Meetily, on your terms

Meetily transcription stays 100% local by default. For summaries, bring your own OpenRouter key (BYOK) so the data path matches the policy you just read - or pick a local model if you want zero retention by construction.

This is the load-bearing distinction on this page. Perplexity documents a Zero Data Retention policy for the Sonar API: it does not retain the data sent via the API. Prompts and responses are processed and then deleted; only billing metadata is kept, and that metadata excludes prompt and response content. Because content is not retained after the request completes, this page records the retention window for Sonar API content as zero.

The authoritative source is Perplexity's API privacy and security documentation, linked as the policy URL above. Review it before deploying any regulated workload, and note that Enterprise plans add organization-level retention controls beyond the API default.

Zero Data Retention is the stated default for the Sonar API rather than an option you have to negotiate. Under it, Perplexity does not retain the data sent via the API, and that data is not used to train or improve models. For teams that need admin-managed retention windows, forced deletion, or org-wide controls, Perplexity Enterprise plans layer those settings on top, but the base Sonar API already operates under zero retention.
The privacy posture flips depending on which Perplexity product you use:
Sonar API (api.perplexity.ai): Zero Data Retention, no training on your content. This is the path Meetily uses.
Consumer Perplexity app (Free, Pro, Max): AI training on user data is enabled by default; you must opt out in Settings, and conversation retention differs from the API.

Your API key means your traffic runs under Perplexity's API terms, so the Zero Data Retention and no-training posture described here applies to what Meetily sends. children.text: Together AI's terms state it does not train on customer data without explicit opt-in, and its API supports zero data retention. Verified policy summary plus how to route Together AI through Meetily as a BYOK summary provider.
Trains on API customer data by default

Together AI's privacy policy is explicit that it does not train on your data without your consent: "We do not use any data collected from you to train our models without your explicit opt-in and consent. You may revoke that consent at any time and request deletion." [1] Together's privacy and security documentation reinforces this, stating that data sharing for training other models is opt-in and not enabled by default. [2]

When Meetily users select Together AI as their summary provider via BYOK, the request hits Together's OpenAI-compatible API under your own API key and your account's settings. The opt-in-only training default applies unless you have separately enabled data sharing for training in your Privacy & Security controls.

Together AI's developer documentation states that Together does not store inputs or outputs by default and that the platform supports zero data retention, while temporary caching may occur for performance unless configured otherwise. [2] Together's customer-facing privacy policy, separately, describes retained prompt and response history that you can view and delete through account settings. [1] Because these two surfaces frame the default differently, this page does not assert a single fixed retention window in days; the authoritative posture for your specific account is the Privacy & Security configuration at api.together.ai/settings/profile read together with the current privacy policy. Reviewing both before deployment is recommended for any regulated workload.

Zero data retention is available on Together AI and is documented as a self-serve control rather than an enterprise-only contract item. You enable it in Privacy & Security under your account profile by declining to store prompts or to allow data for model training. [1][2] Under ZDR, the content you submit and the outputs returned are not stored, retained, or used for model training, product improvements, or any secondary purposes except as needed to provide the service. [1]

Two operational notes matter. First, ZDR applies only from the moment you enable it and does not affect any data processed before that point, so enable it before sending traffic. [1] Second, for organizations the organization-level setting governs all traffic made under that organization's projects and API keys, regardless of which member sends the request. [2]

Meetily routes Together AI traffic through your own API key. Together exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at https://api.together.xyz/v1, which is the base URL you enter in Meetily's BYOK summary configuration. [3] Your account's contract and privacy settings apply to that traffic. The transcript text is sent over TLS to Together for summarization, and the response is returned to Meetily and stored locally on your device. Audio is never transmitted to Together at any point.

If you want stronger guarantees than the cloud default offers, enable zero data retention in your Together account before use, or switch your summary model to a local provider such as Ollama. Meetily's transcription path is already local, so the local-summary route keeps the entire pipeline on your device.

/llm-privacy/xai.title: xAI Grok API Data Retention Policy 2026 - Does xAI Train on Your Data? | Meetily

children.text: xAI's API documentation states it never trains on your API inputs or outputs without explicit permission, with a 30-day audit retention window and enterprise zero data retention available. Crucially, xAI's consumer Privacy Policy does not apply to the API. Verified summary plus how to route Grok through Meetily as a BYOK summary provider.
Trains on API customer data by default

xAI's API security documentation is explicit: xAI never trains on your API inputs or outputs without your explicit permission [1]. That default applies to traffic sent to the xAI API under your own API key, which is the path Meetily uses for BYOK summaries.

This is an important distinction to draw, because xAI's consumer Privacy Policy explicitly does not apply to the API. The Privacy Policy states that it does not apply to data that xAI processes on behalf of customers of its business offerings, such as the xAI API [2][3]. Instead, API traffic is governed by xAI's Data Processing Addendum, under which xAI acts as a processor on the customer's behalf [3]. Reporting and guidance about consumer Grok on X (where public posts and Grok conversations are used for training by default unless you opt out [4]) describes the consumer surface, not the API. None of that consumer-side training behavior describes what happens to a Meetily BYOK request.

By default, xAI's documentation states that API requests and responses are temporarily stored on its servers for 30 days in case they need to be audited for potential abuse or misuse [1]. This is an abuse-monitoring retention window, not a training corpus.

For exact processing terms, geographic scope, and the current subprocessor list, the authoritative source is xAI's Data Processing Addendum, which is incorporated into the Enterprise Terms of Service [3]. Reviewing the DPA before deployment is recommended for any regulated workload.

xAI offers Zero Data Retention as an enterprise feature that prevents xAI from storing any API request or response data, and it is exclusively available to enterprise accounts [1]. Under ZDR, the standard 30-day audit retention does not apply: prompts, completions, and associated metadata are processed in real time but not persisted, and once a response is delivered no record of the exchange remains [1]. Safety and content moderation checks still run in real time, but their results are not stored under ZDR [1]. To enable it, contact xAI sales; it is not a self-serve toggle for standard accounts.

Meetily transcription runs 100% locally by default, and on that path audio never leaves your device. When you select an xAI Grok model as your summary provider in the BYOK flow, Meetily sends transcript text to the xAI API over TLS using your own API key, and the summary is returned to Meetily and stored locally on your device.

The xAI API is OpenAI-compatible: xAI documents that you can use the OpenAI SDK by pointing it at the base URL https://api.x.ai/v1, and most OpenAI-compatible tools work without modification [5]. Meetily configures it as an OpenAI-compatible base URL, so your traffic runs under your own xAI account and its contract terms, not Meetily's.

If you want stronger guarantees than the cloud default offers, switch your summary model to a local provider such as Ollama. Meetily's transcription path is already local, so the local-summary route keeps the entire pipeline on-device.

Two options: ask xAI sales to enable Zero Data Retention on an enterprise account, or switch your Meetily summary model to a local provider like Ollama. Meetily's transcription path is already local, so the local-summary route keeps the entire pipeline on your device with nothing sent to any cloud provider.
Use xAI Grok with Meetily, on your terms

Meetily transcription stays 100% local by default. For summaries, bring your own xAI Grok key (BYOK) so the data path matches the policy you just read - or pick a local model if you want zero retention by construction.

children.q: What is Meetily and how is it different from Fathom?
children.a: Meetily is a bot-free AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Fathom which requires a meeting bot to join calls and uses cloud processing, Meetily captures audio directly from your computer without any visible presence. Key differences: No Meeting Bot (vs bot required), 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Free personal use / Pro $10/user/month billed annually (vs $19-39/month), Complete Privacy (vs third-party processing).

children.q: How much can I save by switching from Fathom to Meetily?
children.a: Meetily Community Edition is free and open source. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually (vs Fathom's $19-39/month) - save 50-75%. Individual users save $228-468 annually with free tier. Enterprise has custom pricing.

children.q: Does Fathom's meeting bot cause any issues?
children.a: Fathom's bot must join meetings as a participant, which can: alert all attendees that recording is happening, be blocked by meeting hosts, fail to join if meetings are full, cause awkward moments in sensitive discussions, and require permissions that may not be available. Meetily has none of these issues.

children.q: Can Meetily work with Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet like Fathom?
children.a: Yes! Meetily works with ANY meeting platform since it captures system audio directly - Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, WebEx, Slack calls, Discord, or any audio playing on your computer. Unlike Fathom which needs specific integrations, Meetily works universally without setup.

children.q: Is Meetily's transcription quality comparable to Fathom?
children.a: Yes, Meetily offers dual transcription engines (Whisper for accuracy, Parakeet for speed) delivering state-of-the-art results. Accuracy varies by audio quality and conditions. The key difference is privacy - Meetily processes locally while Fathom uploads to cloud servers.

children.q: Does Meetily have AI summaries like Fathom?
children.a: Yes! Meetily provides AI-powered meeting summaries, action items, and key points - all processed locally on your device. You get the same intelligent summaries without sending your meeting content to external servers.

children.q: Is Meetily suitable for confidential meetings?
children.a: Absolutely. Meetily is ideal for confidential meetings because: no bot joins (invisible recording), 100% local processing (nothing uploaded), no third-party access, and works offline. For legal, medical, or executive meetings where Fathom's visible bot would be inappropriate, Meetily is the better choice.

children.q: Can I migrate my existing notes from Fathom to Meetily?
children.a: You can export your meeting transcripts and notes from Fathom before switching. While the formats differ, you can keep your historical data for reference. All future meetings with Meetily will be processed locally with complete privacy.

/releases/pro/1.11.1.title: Meetily Pro 1.11.1 - Long Meetings Summarize, Recordings Stay Safe Release Notes | Meetily

children.text: Meetily Pro 1.11.1 - Long Meetings Summarize, Recordings Stay Safe

A fix release. Long meetings that failed to summarize with Built-in AI now work, a failed save no longer puts your recording at risk, summary templates are one click away, and your AI assistant sees the speaker names you saved.
Long meetings now summarize with Built-in AI instead of failing with "Failed to add token to batch"
A failed save of one piece of your recording no longer puts the rest of it at risk
Summary templates are one click away from the meeting page and from Settings > Summary
Speaker names you saved now show in your AI assistant, the command-line tool and exports
Recording keeps going when some audio can't be transcribed, and meetilypro:// links work on Mac when Meetily is closed

Meetily Pro 1.11.1, released on October 14, 2026, is a fix release for Built-in AI summaries and recording. Long meetings that used to fail now summarize with Built-in AI, and a failed save no longer puts your recording at risk. Summary templates are now one click away, and your AI assistant sees the speaker names you saved. There are no breaking changes and nothing to migrate. Meetily still records and transcribes on your own Windows or Mac computer, with no bot joining the call.
If you are on Pro 1.11.0, this is a normal in-place update.
Long Meetings Now Summarize With Built-in AI
With Built-in AI, a long meeting could fail to summarize with the error "Failed to add token to batch". The transcript was too long for the model to read in one go.

Meetily now splits a long transcript into parts sooner, before it gets too long for the model, then summarizes each part and combines them into one summary. Short meetings still summarize in a single pass, the same as before.
A long meeting now takes several steps, so it takes longer to summarize. On a laptop, a very long meeting can take half an hour or more. Let it run.
This release also includes summary fixes for the Qwen 3.5 2B model, so its summaries repeat themselves less.

While you record, Meetily saves your audio in small pieces and joins them when you stop. Before, if saving one piece failed, the pieces after it could fail too, and the recording could be lost. Now Meetily recovers from a failed save and keeps saving the rest of your recording.

children.q: Is Meetily Pro 1.11.1 a big update?
children.a: No. It is a fix release with no breaking changes and nothing to migrate. It fixes summaries for long meetings with Built-in AI, makes recordings safer when a save fails, and adds easier access to summary templates.

children.q: Why did my long meeting fail with "Failed to add token to batch"?
children.a: With Built-in AI, the transcript was too long for the model to read in one go. Meetily Pro 1.11.1 splits a long transcript into parts sooner, before it gets too long for the model, then summarizes each part and combines them into one summary. A long meeting now takes longer to summarize, and on a laptop a very long one can take half an hour or more.

children.q: Can I still lose a recording if saving fails?
children.a: Meetily saves your audio in small pieces while you record and joins them when you stop. In 1.11.1, if saving one piece fails, Meetily recovers and keeps saving the rest, so one failed save no longer puts the whole recording at risk.

children.q: Where are summary templates in Meetily Pro?
children.a: Click the Summary Template button next to Model Settings on the meeting page, or open Settings > Summary.

children.q: Do speaker names show in Claude and other AI assistants?
children.a: Yes. When you name the speakers in a meeting, the names show to your AI assistant when it is connected to Meetily, in the command-line tool, and in exports. Speakers you have not named show as Host and Guest.

children.q: How do I update to Meetily Pro 1.11.1?
children.a: Meetily shows an in-app update dialog; click Update Now! to install. Your settings, recordings and models are kept. You can also download the installer for macOS (Apple Silicon) or Windows from the Meetily Pro downloads page.

children.q: How long does my Meetily Pro trial last?
children.a: The trial is 14 days of full Pro features, with no payment or card required. After it ends you have a 1-day grace period before Pro features lock.

children.q: Where do I find my license key?
children.a: Your key is saved on this device and emailed to you when you start the trial. Copy it from this page, download it as a .txt, or open your inbox for the message from Meetily.

children.q: How do I activate my trial?
children.a: Download Meetily for macOS or Windows, install it, and open the app. At the license step, paste your key to activate your 14-day Pro trial.

children.q: Do I have to activate right away?

children.q: Is my data private during the trial?
children.a: All your data processing, storage and recording happens locally. You own your data unless you choose external providers. See our privacy references for LLM and BYOK details.

children.q: What happens when the trial ends?
children.a: Take the time you need to be sure Meetily is the right fit. If your trial is running low, just reach out and we're glad to extend it. Whenever you're ready, subscribe to Pro to keep the Pro features, or keep using the free, open-source Community edition.

Warum reichen die meisten Meeting-Recorder nicht aus?

Datenschutz-Albtraeume - Cloud-basierte Tools, die alles auf US-Server hochladen
Bot-abhaengig - Tools, die einen unangenehmen "Notetaker"-Bot hinzufuegen, der fuer alle Teilnehmer sichtbar ist

KI-Meeting-Aufnahme-Tools nutzen Sprache-zu-Text-Modelle, um Ihre Meetings automatisch zu transkribieren, Sprecher zu identifizieren und Zusammenfassungen mit Aktionspunkten zu erstellen. Die besten KI-Sprachrecorder fuer Meetings in 2026 kombinieren praezise Transkription mit nuetzlicher Nachbesprechungsintelligenz.

Meetily verwendet OpenAI Whisper und NVIDIA Parakeet Modelle lokal und bietet hohe Genauigkeit fuer klares englisches Audio. Da die Verarbeitung auf dem Geraet stattfindet, wird Ihr Meeting-Audio nie an einen Server gesendet. Dies macht es zur einzigen KI-Meeting-Aufnahme-Software, die architekturbedingt HIPAA- und DSGVO-konform ist.
Fathom bietet Cloud-basierte KI-Zusammenfassungen mit Highlights und Videoclips. Die kostenlose Stufe gibt Ihnen 5 KI-Zusammenfassungen pro Monat bei unbegrenzter Transkription.
Otter.ai ist bekannt fuer Echtzeit-KI-Transkription waehrend Meetings, unterstuetzt aber nur Englisch, Franzoesisch und Spanisch.

OBS Studio und plattformnative Recorder (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) enthalten keine KI-Transkription in ihren kostenlosen Stufen. Wenn KI-gesteuerte Meeting-Aufnahme-Tools mit Transkription eine Anforderung sind, waehlen Sie eines der fuenf oben aufgefuehrten Tools.
Warum ist Datenschutz bei Meeting-Aufnahmen wichtig?
Wenn Sie ein Meeting aufnehmen, erfassen Sie potenziell sensible Informationen:
Persoenliche Details, die im Gespraech geteilt werden

Cloud-basierte Meeting-Aufnahme-Tools speichern all dies auf ihren Servern. Selbst mit Verschluesselung vertrauen Sie einem Dritten Ihre sensibelsten Gespraeche an. Einige Tools, wie Granola, trainieren ihre KI-Modelle standardmaessig mit Ihren Meeting-Daten

 (Opt-out ist nur in der Enterprise-Stufe ab 35+$/Nutzer/Monat verfuegbar).

Fuer europaeische Unternehmen kann das Senden von Meeting-Aufnahmen an US-basierte Cloud-Dienste DSGVO-Compliance-Probleme verursachen. Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai und Fathom verarbeiten alle Daten auf US-Servern. Lokale Aufnahme mit Tools wie Meetily eliminiert dieses Risiko vollstaendig. Sehen Sie unseren DSGVO-Compliance-Leitfaden fuer weitere Details.
Warum ist "OBS Alternative fuer Meetings" eine Top-Suche?
OBS Studio ist leistungsstark, wurde aber nicht als Meeting-Aufnahme-Software entwickelt. Hier ist, warum Leute nach OBS-Alternativen suchen:
Komplexe Einrichtung - Virtuelles Audio-Routing erfordert die Konfiguration von Tools wie VB-Cable oder BlackHole
Keine Transkription - OBS nimmt Video und Audio auf, nicht Text
Ueberdimensionierte Funktionen - Die meisten Nutzer brauchen 5% von dem, was OBS bietet
Keine Meeting-spezifischen Funktionen - Keine Sprecheridentifikation, Aktionspunkte oder KI-Zusammenfassungen
Meetily ist im Wesentlichen "OBS fuer Meetings" - alle lokalen, privaten Aufnahmevorteile ohne die Komplexitaet, plus integrierte KI-Transkription.
Wie waehle ich die richtige Meeting-Recorder-Software?

Wenn Sie reisen, in Gebieten mit unzuverlaessigem Internet arbeiten oder in Air-Gapped-Umgebungen aufnehmen muessen, waehlen Sie Meetily oder OBS. Alle Cloud-basierten Tools (Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, tl;dv) erfordern eine stabile Internetverbindung.

Wenn Sie sensible Geschaeftsgespraeche, Gesundheitsdiskussionen, juristische Meetings oder Finanzpruefungen aufnehmen, sind lokale KI-Meeting-Aufnahme-Tools wie Meetily die sicherste Wahl. Kein Cloud-Anbieter kann Daten leaken, die Ihr Geraet nie verlassen haben.

Wenn Sie Kundengespraeche, Vertriebsdemos oder Meetings aufnehmen, bei denen ein sichtbarer "Notetaker"-Bot unprofessionell waere, waehlen Sie bot-freie Tools: Meetily (lokal, Open Source) oder Granola (Cloud, kostenpflichtig). Wenn Ihr Workflow erfordert, dass Meeting-Notizen automatisch mit Salesforce, HubSpot oder Pipedrive synchronisiert werden, ist Fireflies.ai die staerkste Option. Meetily bietet derzeit keine CRM-Integrationen an.

Wenn Sie durchsuchbare, textbasierte Aufzeichnungen Ihrer Meetings wuenschen, waehlen Sie ein Tool mit KI-Transkription (Meetily, Fathom, Otter, Fireflies oder tl;dv) statt einfacher Bildschirmaufnahme (OBS, Loom).

children.q: Ist Meetily wirklich kostenlos?
children.a: Ja, Meetily ist 100% kostenlos und Open Source unter der MIT-Lizenz. Es gibt keine kostenpflichtige Stufe, keine Funktionseinschraenkungen und kein erforderliches Abonnement. Die Community Edition enthaelt alle Kernfunktionen. Pro-Funktionen wie erweiterte KI-Modelle sind gegen eine einmalige Gebuehr erhaeltlich, aber der Kern-Recorder ist fuer immer kostenlos.

children.q: Funktioniert Meetily mit Zoom, Teams und Google Meet?
children.a: Ja, Meetily nimmt jede Meeting-Plattform auf, da es Ihr System-Audio und Ihren Bildschirm erfasst. Es ist plattformunabhaengig und funktioniert mit Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Discord, Slack Huddles, Webex und jeder anderen Plattform, die Audio ueber Ihren Computer ausgibt.

children.q: Koennen andere Meeting-Teilnehmer sehen, dass Meetily aufnimmt?
children.a: Nein. Meetily ist bot-frei, was bedeutet, dass es keine sichtbare Praesenz zu Ihren Meetings hinzufuegt. Anders als Fireflies oder Otter.ai, die als Notetaker-Bot beitreten, erfasst Meetily Audio lokal. Nur Sie wissen, dass es aufnimmt. Sie sollten dennoch die geltenden Einwilligungsgesetze beachten und Teilnehmer ueber die Aufnahme informieren.

children.q: Wo werden meine Aufnahmen gespeichert?
children.a: Alle Aufnahmen werden lokal auf Ihrem Computer in einem von Ihnen gewaehlten Ordner gespeichert. Nichts wird jemals in einen Cloud-Dienst hochgeladen. Sie haben die vollstaendige Kontrolle ueber Ihre Daten - Sie koennen sie sichern, verschluesseln oder jederzeit loeschen. Dies ist ideal fuer DSGVO-, HIPAA- und andere Compliance-Anforderungen.

children.q: Benoetigt Meetily Internet zum Funktionieren?
children.a: Nein. Einmal installiert und mit heruntergeladenen KI-Modellen funktioniert Meetily vollstaendig offline. Die KI-Transkription laeuft auf Ihrem lokalen Rechner mit Whisper- oder Parakeet-Engines. Nur der erste Download erfordert Internet. Dies macht es perfekt fuer Air-Gapped-Umgebungen oder unzuverlaessige Verbindungen.

children.q: Wie genau ist Meetilys Transkription?
children.a: Meetily verwendet OpenAIs Whisper-Modell, das hohe Genauigkeit fuer klares Audio auf Englisch bietet und 99+ Sprachen unterstuetzt. Das Large v3-Modell bietet die beste Genauigkeit, waehrend kleinere Modelle (Base, Small) schnellere Leistung auf aelterer Hardware bieten.

children.q: Was sind die Systemanforderungen fuer Meetily?
children.a: Minimum: Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5 unter Windows oder ein Mac mit Apple Silicon, 8GB RAM, 2GB Speicher. Empfohlen: Moderner CPU mit 16GB+ RAM, GPU-Beschleunigung (NVIDIA, AMD oder Apple Silicon), SSD-Speicher. Das Whisper Tiny-Modell funktioniert auf aelterer Hardware, waehrend groessere Modelle von neueren Systemen profitieren.

children.q: Ist Meetily DSGVO- und HIPAA-konform?
children.a: Ja, von Grund auf. Da alle Verarbeitung lokal ohne Cloud-Uploads erfolgt, behalten Sie die vollstaendige Datensouveraenitaet. Daten verlassen nie Ihre Infrastruktur und erfuellen die EU-Datenresidenzanforderungen. Keine Drittanbieter-Verarbeiter sind involviert, was BAA-Anforderungen fuer HIPAA eliminiert. Der Open-Source-Code ermoeglicht Sicherheitsaudits.

children.q: Wie kann ich ein Meeting aufnehmen, ohne Zooms integrierten Recorder zu verwenden?
children.a: Verwenden Sie einen eigenstaendigen Meeting-Recorder wie Meetily, der Ihr System-Audio direkt erfasst. Installieren Sie es auf Ihrem Computer, starten Sie die Aufnahme vor Ihrem Zoom-Anruf und es wird alles erfassen, ohne Zooms native Aufnahme zu nutzen. Das bedeutet, dass keine Aufnahmebenachrichtigung an die Teilnehmer gesendet wird (obwohl Sie sie gemaess den Einwilligungsgesetzen dennoch informieren sollten), und Ihre Aufnahme bleibt auf Ihrem lokalen Geraet statt auf Zooms Cloud-Servern.

children.q: Welche Meeting-Recorder funktionieren sowohl fuer persoenliche als auch fuer Online-Meetings?
children.a: Meetily und OBS Studio funktionieren beide fuer persoenliche Meetings, da sie Audio ueber das Mikrofon Ihres Geraets erfassen. Fuer persoenliche Meetings platzieren Sie Ihren Laptop im Raum und Meetily wird mit seiner KI-Engine aufnehmen und transkribieren. Fuer Online-Meetings erfasst es System-Audio. Die meisten Cloud-basierten Tools wie Otter.ai und Fireflies funktionieren nur, indem sie Online-Meetings ueber einen Bot beitreten.

children.q: Gibt es Meeting-Recorder, die Audio nicht in der Cloud speichern?
children.a: Ja. Meetily speichert alles lokal auf Ihrem Computer ohne Cloud-Uploads. OBS Studio nimmt ebenfalls lokal auf. Zoom bietet lokale Aufnahme (nicht Cloud) in seiner kostenlosen Stufe. Alle anderen Tools in dieser Liste - Fathom, Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai und tl;dv - laden Ihr Meeting-Audio zur Verarbeitung auf Cloud-Server hoch.

children.text: Die beste kostenlose Meeting-Recorder-Software in 2026 ist nicht die mit den meisten Funktionen - es ist die, die zu Ihrer tatsaechlichen Arbeitsweise passt.

Fuer datenschutzorientierte Nutzer bietet Meetily die ideale Balance: lokale KI-Transkription, bot-freie Aufnahme, Offline-Faehigkeit und Open-Source-Transparenz. Es ist das, was OBS waere, wenn es speziell als Meeting-Aufnahme-Software entwickelt worden waere.

children.q: ¿Meetily funciona con Zoom, Teams y Google Meet?
children.a: Sí, Meetily graba cualquier plataforma de reuniones porque captura el audio del sistema y la pantalla. Es agnóstico a la plataforma y funciona con Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Discord, Slack Huddles, Webex, y cualquier otra plataforma que emita audio a través de tu computadora.

children.q: ¿Pueden otros participantes ver que Meetily está grabando?
children.a: No. Meetily no usa bots, lo que significa que no añade ninguna presencia visible a tus reuniones. A diferencia de Fireflies u Otter.ai que se unen como un bot Notetaker, Meetily captura audio localmente. Solo tú sabes que está grabando. Aún deberías seguir las leyes de consentimiento apropiadas e informar a los participantes cuando grabas.

children.q: ¿Dónde se almacenan mis grabaciones?
children.a: Todas las grabaciones se almacenan localmente en tu computadora en una carpeta que elijas. Nada se sube nunca a ningún servicio en la nube. Tienes control completo sobre tus datos - puedes respaldarlo, cifrarlo o eliminarlo en cualquier momento. Esto es ideal para requisitos de cumplimiento RGPD, HIPAA y otros.

children.q: ¿Meetily requiere internet para funcionar?
children.a: No. Una vez instalado y con los modelos de IA descargados, Meetily funciona completamente offline. La transcripción con IA se ejecuta en tu máquina local usando motores Whisper o Parakeet. Solo la descarga inicial requiere internet. Esto lo hace perfecto para entornos aislados o conexiones poco confiables.

children.q: ¿Qué tan precisa es la transcripción de Meetily?
children.a: Meetily usa el modelo Whisper de OpenAI que ofrece alta precisión para audio claro en inglés, y soporta 99+ idiomas. El modelo Large v3 proporciona la mejor precisión, mientras que modelos más pequeños (Base, Small) ofrecen rendimiento más rápido en hardware antiguo.

children.q: ¿Cuáles son los requisitos del sistema para Meetily?
children.a: Mínimo: Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5 en Windows, o un Mac con Apple Silicon, 8GB RAM, 2GB almacenamiento. Recomendado: CPU moderno con 16GB+ RAM, aceleración GPU (NVIDIA, AMD o Apple Silicon), almacenamiento SSD. El modelo Whisper Tiny funciona en hardware antiguo, mientras que modelos más grandes se benefician de sistemas más nuevos.

children.q: ¿Meetily cumple con RGPD y HIPAA?
children.a: Sí, por diseño. Como todo el procesamiento ocurre localmente sin subidas a la nube, mantienes soberanía completa de datos. Los datos nunca salen de tu infraestructura, cumpliendo los requisitos de residencia de datos de la UE. No hay procesadores de terceros involucrados, eliminando los requisitos BAA para HIPAA. El código abierto permite auditorías de seguridad.

children.q: ¿Cómo puedo grabar una reunión sin usar el grabador integrado de Zoom?
children.a: Usa un grabador de reuniones independiente como Meetily que captura el audio del sistema directamente. Instálalo en tu computadora, inicia la grabación antes de tu llamada de Zoom, y capturará todo sin usar la grabación nativa de Zoom. Esto significa que no se envía notificación de grabación a los participantes (aunque deberías informarles según las leyes de consentimiento), y tu grabación permanece en tu dispositivo local en lugar de los servidores en la nube de Zoom.

children.q: ¿Qué grabadores de reuniones funcionan tanto para reuniones presenciales como en línea?
children.a: Meetily y OBS Studio funcionan para reuniones presenciales porque capturan audio desde el micrófono de tu dispositivo. Para reuniones presenciales, coloca tu laptop en la sala y Meetily grabará y transcribirá usando su motor de IA. Para reuniones en línea, captura el audio del sistema. La mayoría de las herramientas basadas en la nube como Otter.ai y Fireflies solo funcionan uniéndose a reuniones en línea a través de un bot.

children.q: ¿Existen grabadores de reuniones que no almacenen audio en la nube?
children.a: Sí. Meetily almacena todo localmente en tu computadora sin subidas a la nube. OBS Studio también graba localmente. Zoom ofrece grabación local (no en la nube) en su nivel gratuito. Todas las demás herramientas en esta lista - Fathom, Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai y tl;dv - suben el audio de tu reunión a servidores en la nube para procesamiento.

Se voce precisa especificamente de um software de gravacao de reunioes com IA que inclua transcricao e resumos, suas opcoes se restringem. Nem todo gravador de reunioes inclui recursos de IA, e a qualidade varia muito.

Ferramentas de gravacao de reunioes com IA usam modelos de conversao de voz para texto para transcrever automaticamente suas reunioes, identificar falantes e gerar resumos com itens de acao. Os melhores gravadores de voz com IA para reunioes em 2026 combinam transcricao precisa com inteligencia pos-reuniao util.
Veja como as opcoes de software de gravacao de reunioes com IA se comparam:

Meetily usa modelos OpenAI Whisper e NVIDIA Parakeet localmente, oferecendo alta precisao para audio claro em ingles. Como o processamento acontece no dispositivo, o audio da sua reuniao nunca e enviado para nenhum servidor. Isso o torna o unico software de gravacao de reunioes com IA que e compativel com HIPAA e LGPD por arquitetura.
Fathom fornece resumos com IA baseados na nuvem com destaques e clips de video. O nivel gratuito oferece 5 resumos com IA por mes, com transcricao ilimitada.
Otter.ai e conhecido pela transcricao com IA em tempo real durante reunioes, mas suporta apenas ingles, frances e espanhol.

Fireflies.ai adiciona inteligencia de conversacao e analise de sentimento alem da transcricao, tornando-o o software de gravacao de reunioes com IA mais completo em recursos para equipes de vendas. Suporta 100+ idiomas.
tl;dv oferece relatorios com IA de multiplas reunioes que analisam padroes em suas chamadas, util para coaching de vendas e revisoes de equipe. Suporta 30+ idiomas.

OBS Studio e os gravadores nativos de plataformas (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) nao incluem transcricao com IA em seus niveis gratuitos. Se ferramentas de gravacao de reunioes com IA com transcricao sao um requisito, escolha uma das cinco ferramentas listadas acima.
Por Que a Privacidade Importa na Gravacao de Reunioes?
Quando voce grava uma reuniao, esta capturando informacoes potencialmente sensiveis:
Conversas com clientes e termos de contratos

Ferramentas de gravacao de reunioes baseadas na nuvem armazenam tudo isso em seus servidores. Mesmo com criptografia, voce esta confiando suas conversas mais sensiveis a terceiros. Algumas ferramentas, como Granola, treinam seus modelos de IA com seus dados de reunioes por padrao
(opens in new tab)
 (a opcao de exclusao so esta disponivel no nivel Enterprise a $35+/usuario/mes).

Para empresas brasileiras, enviar gravacoes de reunioes para servicos de nuvem baseados nos EUA pode criar problemas de conformidade com a LGPD. Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai e Fathom processam dados em servidores nos EUA. Gravacao local com ferramentas como Meetily elimina esse risco completamente. Consulte nosso guia de conformidade LGPD para mais detalhes.
Por Que "Alternativa ao OBS para Reunioes" e uma Busca Popular?
OBS Studio e poderoso, mas nao foi projetado como software de gravacao de reunioes. Veja por que as pessoas buscam alternativas ao OBS:
Configuracao complexa - O roteamento de audio virtual requer configurar ferramentas como VB-Cable ou BlackHole
Sem transcricao - OBS grava video e audio, nao texto
Recursos excessivos - A maioria dos usuarios precisa de 5% do que o OBS oferece
Sem recursos especificos para reunioes - Sem identificacao de falantes, itens de acao ou resumos com IA
Meetily e essencialmente "OBS para reunioes" - todos os beneficios de gravacao local e privada sem a complexidade, mais transcricao com IA integrada.
Como Escolher o Software Gravador de Reunioes Certo?
Faca a si mesmo estas perguntas:

Se voce viaja, trabalha em areas com internet nao confiavel, ou precisa gravar em ambientes isolados, escolha Meetily ou OBS. Todas as ferramentas baseadas na nuvem (Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, tl;dv) requerem uma conexao de internet estavel.

Se voce esta gravando conversas de negocios sensiveis, discussoes de saude, reunioes juridicas ou revisoes financeiras, ferramentas locais de gravacao de reunioes com IA como Meetily sao a escolha mais segura. Nenhum provedor de nuvem pode vazar dados que nunca sairam do seu dispositivo.
Voce precisa que o bot de gravacao seja invisivel?

Se voce grava chamadas com clientes, demos de vendas, ou qualquer reuniao onde um bot "Notetaker" visivel seria constrangedor ou nao profissional, escolha ferramentas sem bot: Meetily (local, codigo aberto) ou Granola (nuvem, pago). A maioria das outras ferramentas incluindo Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom e tl;dv adiciona um bot visivel.
Voce precisa de integracao com CRM?

Se seu fluxo de trabalho requer que as notas de reuniao sejam sincronizadas automaticamente com Salesforce, HubSpot ou Pipedrive, Fireflies.ai e a opcao mais forte. Meetily nao oferece integracoes com CRM neste momento.

Se voce quer registros pesquisaveis em texto das suas reunioes, escolha uma ferramenta com transcricao com IA (Meetily, Fathom, Otter, Fireflies ou tl;dv) em vez de gravacao basica de tela (OBS, Loom).
Qual e o seu nivel tecnico?

OBS requer conhecimento tecnico significativo. Todas as outras ferramentas nesta lista sao projetadas para configuracao rapida, com Meetily e ferramentas na nuvem prontos para gravar em menos de 5 minutos.

children.q: Meetily e realmente gratis?
children.a: Sim, Meetily e 100% gratis e codigo aberto sob a licenca MIT. Nao ha nivel pago, sem limitacoes de recursos e sem assinatura necessaria. A Edicao Comunidade inclui todos os recursos principais. Recursos Pro como modelos de IA aprimorados estao disponiveis por uma taxa unica, mas o gravador principal e gratis para sempre.

children.q: Meetily funciona com Zoom, Teams e Google Meet?
children.a: Sim, Meetily grava qualquer plataforma de reunioes porque captura o audio do sistema e a tela. E agnostico de plataforma e funciona com Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Discord, Slack Huddles, Webex e qualquer outra plataforma que emita audio pelo seu computador.

children.q: Outros participantes podem ver que Meetily esta gravando?
children.a: Nao. Meetily e livre de bots, o que significa que nao adiciona nenhuma presenca visivel as suas reunioes. Diferente de Fireflies ou Otter.ai que entram como um bot Notetaker, Meetily captura audio localmente. So voce sabe que esta gravando. Voce ainda deve seguir as leis de consentimento apropriadas e informar os participantes ao gravar.

children.q: Onde minhas gravacoes sao armazenadas?
children.a: Todas as gravacoes sao armazenadas localmente no seu computador em uma pasta que voce escolher. Nada e enviado para qualquer servico de nuvem. Voce tem controle total sobre seus dados - pode fazer backup, criptografar ou excluir a qualquer momento. Isso e ideal para requisitos de conformidade LGPD, HIPAA e outros.

children.q: Meetily precisa de internet para funcionar?
children.a: Nao. Uma vez instalado e com os modelos de IA baixados, Meetily funciona completamente offline. A transcricao com IA roda na sua maquina local usando os motores Whisper ou Parakeet. Apenas o download inicial requer internet. Isso o torna perfeito para ambientes isolados ou conexoes nao confiaveis.

children.q: Quao precisa e a transcricao do Meetily?
children.a: Meetily usa o modelo Whisper da OpenAI que oferece alta precisao para audio claro em ingles, e suporta 99+ idiomas. O modelo Large v3 fornece a melhor precisao, enquanto modelos menores (Base, Small) oferecem desempenho mais rapido em hardware mais antigo.

children.q: Quais sao os requisitos de sistema para Meetily?
children.a: Minimo: Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5 no Windows, ou um Mac com Apple Silicon, 8GB RAM, 2GB armazenamento. Recomendado: CPU moderno com 16GB+ RAM, aceleracao GPU (NVIDIA, AMD ou Apple Silicon), armazenamento SSD. O modelo Whisper Tiny funciona em hardware mais antigo, enquanto modelos maiores se beneficiam de sistemas mais novos.

children.q: Meetily e compativel com LGPD e HIPAA?
children.a: Sim, por design. Como todo o processamento acontece localmente sem uploads para nuvem, voce mantem soberania completa dos dados. Os dados nunca saem da sua infraestrutura, atendendo aos requisitos de residencia de dados. Nenhum processador terceiro esta envolvido, eliminando requisitos BAA para HIPAA. O codigo aberto permite auditorias de seguranca.

children.q: Como posso gravar uma reuniao sem usar o gravador integrado do Zoom?
children.a: Use um gravador de reunioes independente como Meetily que captura o audio do sistema diretamente. Instale-o no seu computador, inicie a gravacao antes da sua chamada no Zoom, e ele capturara tudo sem usar a gravacao nativa do Zoom. Isso significa que nenhuma notificacao de gravacao e enviada aos participantes (embora voce ainda deva informa-los conforme as leis de consentimento), e sua gravacao fica no seu dispositivo local em vez dos servidores na nuvem do Zoom.

children.q: Quais gravadores de reunioes funcionam tanto para reunioes presenciais quanto online?
children.a: Meetily e OBS Studio funcionam para reunioes presenciais porque capturam audio do microfone do seu dispositivo. Para reunioes presenciais, coloque seu laptop na sala e Meetily gravara e transcrevera usando seu motor de IA. Para reunioes online, ele captura o audio do sistema. A maioria das ferramentas baseadas na nuvem como Otter.ai e Fireflies so funcionam entrando em reunioes online via bot.

children.q: Existem gravadores de reunioes que nao armazenam audio na nuvem?
children.a: Sim. Meetily armazena tudo localmente no seu computador sem uploads para nuvem. OBS Studio tambem grava localmente. O Zoom oferece gravacao local (nao na nuvem) no nivel gratuito. Todas as outras ferramentas nesta lista - Fathom, Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai e tl;dv - enviam o audio da sua reuniao para servidores na nuvem para processamento.

children.text: O melhor software gravador de reunioes gratis em 2026 nao e o que tem mais recursos - e o que se encaixa na forma como voce realmente trabalha.

Para usuarios focados em privacidade, Meetily oferece o equilibrio ideal: transcricao local com IA, gravacao sem bot, capacidade offline e transparencia de codigo aberto. E o que o OBS seria se fosse projetado especificamente como software de gravacao de reunioes.

Para equipes de vendas que precisam de integracao com CRM, Fireflies.ai e a opcao mais capaz apesar do bot visivel e limitacoes de armazenamento.

Para todos os outros: a era de configuracao complicada e ferramentas na nuvem que comprometem a privacidade acabou. Experimente Meetily e descubra como o software de gravacao de reunioes deveria ser - simples, privado e simplesmente funciona.

children.text: 最佳免费AI会议录制软件和AI语音录制器
children.id: 最佳免费ai会议录制软件和ai语音录制器

children.text: 如果您特别需要具有转录和摘要功能的AI会议录制软件，可选范围会缩小。并非每款会议录制器都包含AI功能，而且质量参差不齐。
AI会议录制工具使用语音转文字模型自动转录您的会议、识别发言人，并生成带有行动项的摘要。2026年最佳会议AI语音录制器将准确的转录与有用的会后智能相结合。
以下是各AI会议录制软件选项的对比：
Meetily 在本地使用OpenAI Whisper和NVIDIA Parakeet模型，对清晰的英语音频提供高准确度。由于处理在设备上完成，您的会议音频永远不会发送到任何服务器。这使其成为唯一从架构上就符合HIPAA和GDPR的AI会议录制软件。
Fathom 提供基于云端的AI摘要，包含高亮和视频片段。免费层级每月提供5次AI摘要，转录无限制。
Otter.ai 以会议期间的实时AI转录著称，但仅支持英语、法语和西班牙语。
Fireflies.ai 在转录基础上增加了对话智能和情感分析，使其成为销售团队功能最丰富的AI会议录制软件。支持100+种语言。
tl;dv 提供跨多个通话的AI报告分析模式，适用于销售辅导和团队回顾。支持30+种语言。
OBS Studio和平台原生录制器（Zoom、Teams、Google Meet）在免费层级中不包含AI转录。如果具有转录功能的AI会议录制工具是必要需求，请选择上述五款工具之一。
为什么会议录制的隐私很重要？
children.id: 为什么会议录制的隐私很重要

children.text: 当您录制会议时，您可能正在捕获敏感信息：
对话中分享的个人详情

基于云端的会议录制工具将所有这些存储在他们的服务器上。即使有加密，您也在将最敏感的对话托付给第三方。一些工具，如Granola，默认使用您的会议数据训练其AI模型
(opens in new tab)
（退出选项仅在$35+/用户/月的企业版中提供）。
对于欧洲企业，将会议录制发送到美国的云服务可能会产生GDPR合规问题。Otter.ai、Fireflies.ai和Fathom都在美国服务器上处理数据。使用Meetily等工具进行本地录制可以完全消除这一风险。查看我们的GDPR合规指南了解更多详情。
为什么"会议OBS替代方案"是热门搜索？
children.id: 为什么会议obs替代方案是热门搜索

children.text: OBS Studio功能强大，但它不是专门为会议录制软件设计的。以下是人们搜索OBS替代方案的原因：
设置复杂 - 虚拟音频路由需要配置VB-Cable或BlackHole等工具
无转录功能 - OBS录制视频和音频，不是文字
功能过多 - 大多数用户只需要OBS提供功能的5%
无会议特定功能 - 无发言人识别、行动项或AI摘要
Meetily本质上是"会议版OBS" - 拥有所有本地、私密录制的优势，没有复杂性，还内置了AI转录。
如何选择合适的会议录制软件？
children.id: 如何选择合适的会议录制软件

children.text: 如果您经常出差、在网络不稳定的地区工作，或需要在气隙环境中录制，选择 Meetily 或OBS。所有云端工具（Otter、Fireflies、Fathom、tl;dv）都需要稳定的互联网连接。
如果您正在录制敏感的商业对话、医疗讨论、法律会议或财务审核，像 Meetily 这样的本地AI会议录制工具是最安全的选择。没有云提供商可以泄露从未离开您设备的数据。
您需要录制机器人不可见吗？
children.id: 您需要录制机器人不可见吗

children.text: 如果您录制客户通话、销售演示或任何可见Notetaker机器人会显得尴尬或不专业的会议，选择无机器人工具：Meetily（本地，开源）或Granola（云端，付费）。包括Otter.ai、Fireflies、Fathom和tl;dv在内的大多数其他工具都会添加可见的机器人。
如果您的工作流程要求会议记录自动同步到Salesforce、HubSpot或Pipedrive，Fireflies.ai 是最强的选择。Meetily目前不提供CRM集成。
如果您想要可搜索的、基于文字的会议记录，选择具有AI转录功能的工具（Meetily、Fathom、Otter、Fireflies或tl;dv），而不是基本的屏幕录制（OBS、Loom）。
OBS需要大量的技术知识。此列表中的其他所有工具都设计用于快速设置，Meetily 和云端工具可在5分钟内开始录制。

Meetily能与Zoom、Teams和Google Meet一起使用吗？
是的，Meetily可以录制任何会议平台，因为它捕获系统音频和屏幕。它是平台无关的，可与Zoom、Microsoft Teams、Google Meet、Discord、Slack Huddles、Webex以及任何通过您的电脑输出音频的平台一起使用。
其他会议参与者能看到Meetily在录制吗？
不能。Meetily是无机器人的，这意味着它不会在您的会议中添加任何可见的存在。与Fireflies或Otter.ai以Notetaker机器人身份加入不同，Meetily在本地捕获音频。只有您知道它在录制。您仍应遵守适当的同意法律，并在录制时通知参与者。
所有录制都本地存储在您选择的文件夹中的电脑上。不会上传到任何云服务。您完全控制您的数据--可以随时备份、加密或删除。这非常适合GDPR、HIPAA和其他合规要求。
Meetily需要互联网才能工作吗？
不需要。安装完成并下载AI模型后，Meetily完全离线工作。AI转录使用Whisper或Parakeet引擎在本地机器上运行。只有初始下载需要互联网。这使其非常适合气隙环境或不可靠的连接。
Meetily使用OpenAI的Whisper模型，对清晰的英语音频提供高准确度，支持99+种语言。Large v3模型提供最佳准确度，而较小的模型（Base、Small）在较旧的硬件上提供更快的性能。
最低配置：Windows 需 Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5，Mac 需 Apple Silicon 芯片，8GB RAM、2GB存储。推荐配置：现代CPU配16GB+ RAM、GPU加速（NVIDIA、AMD或Apple Silicon）、SSD存储。Whisper Tiny模型可在较旧的硬件上工作，而较大的模型受益于较新的系统。
是的，从设计上就符合。由于所有处理都在本地进行，没有云端上传，您保持完全的数据主权。数据永远不会离开您的基础设施，符合欧盟数据驻留要求。不涉及第三方处理器，消除了HIPAA的BAA要求。开源代码允许安全审计。
如何在不使用Zoom内置录制器的情况下录制会议？
使用像Meetily这样的独立会议录制器，直接捕获系统音频。在电脑上安装后，在Zoom通话前开始录制，它会在不使用Zoom原生录制功能的情况下捕获所有内容。这意味着不会向参与者发送录制通知（但您仍应根据同意法律告知他们），您的录制保留在本地设备上而不是Zoom的云服务器。
哪些会议录制器同时适用于线下和在线会议？
Meetily和OBS Studio都适用于线下会议，因为它们可以从设备麦克风捕获音频。对于线下会议，将笔记本电脑放在房间里，Meetily将使用其AI引擎录制和转录。对于在线会议，它捕获系统音频。大多数云端工具如Otter.ai和Fireflies只能通过机器人加入在线会议。
有没有不在云端存储音频的会议录制器？
有。Meetily将所有内容本地存储在您的电脑上，不进行任何云端上传。OBS Studio也在本地录制。Zoom在免费层级提供本地录制（非云端）。此列表中的所有其他工具--Fathom、Otter.ai、Fireflies.ai和tl;dv--都会将您的会议音频上传到云服务器进行处理。
2026年最佳免费会议录制软件不是功能最多的那个--而是真正适合您工作方式的那个。
对于注重隐私的用户，Meetily 提供了理想的平衡：本地AI转录、无机器人录制、离线功能和开源透明度。它就是如果OBS专门作为会议录制软件设计会是什么样子。
对于无限免费云端录制，Fathom 以无时间上限和免费层级无存储限制脱颖而出。
对于需要CRM集成的销售团队，Fireflies.ai 是最强大的选择，尽管它有可见的机器人和存储限制。
对于其他所有人：复杂设置和牺牲隐私的云端工具的时代已经结束。试试 Meetily，体验会议录制软件应该是什么样子--简单、私密、就是能用。

children.text:
AI会议助手安全吗？ 并非所有都安全。2025年，Otter.ai因未经同意录制而面临集体诉讼
(opens in new tab)
，Fireflies.ai因收集生物识别数据被起诉
(opens in new tab)
，查普曼大学因安全问题禁止使用Read AI
(opens in new tab)
。云端会议工具存在真实的隐私风险：数据存储在第三方服务器上、AI使用您的对话进行训练、未经适当同意就进行录制。要实现真正安全的会议转录，本地处理（如Meetily）可将您的数据保留在您的设备上。

目前，超过62%的组织
(opens in new tab)
使用AI会议助手。市场规模在2025年已爆发式增长至35亿美元
(opens in new tab)
，预计到2035年将达到340亿美元。
但随着采用率的增长，诉讼、大学禁令和隐私丑闻也在增加。
如果您正在使用基于云端的会议AI，您需要了解其中的风险。如果您正在评估各种选项，本指南将帮助您区分安全的工具和存在问题的工具。
警钟：2025年AI会议助手诉讼案
children.id: 警钟2025年ai会议助手诉讼案

children.text:
2025年8月，Justin Brewer在加州联邦法院对Otter.ai提起集体诉讼
(opens in new tab)
。指控相当严重：
"该公司的AI驱动转录服务……默认情况下不会征求会议参与者的录制许可，也未能提醒参与者录音内容会与Otter共享以改进其人工智能系统。"

起诉书
(opens in new tab)
中的主要指控：
Otter的"OtterPilot"未经所有参与者同意就自动加入会议
会议数据被用于训练Otter的AI模型，但未获得明确许可
该服务将获取同意的义务转嫁给客户，而非直接获取

违反了电子通信隐私法（ECPA）
(opens in new tab)
、计算机欺诈和滥用法（CFAA）
(opens in new tab)
和加州侵犯隐私法（CIPA）
(opens in new tab)

该案件（Brewer诉Otter.ai Inc.，案件编号5:25-cv-06911）仍在审理中，Otter的答辩截止日期已延至2025年11月
(opens in new tab)
。

加州法律要求在录制对话前获得所有各方的同意
(opens in new tab)
。Otter仅向会议主持人（而非所有参与者）寻求同意的做法直接违反了这一要求。

仅仅几个月后，Fireflies.ai也面临法律挑战
(opens in new tab)
。伊利诺伊州居民Katelin Cruz提起诉讼，指控：
"Fireflies.AI的会议助手录制、分析、转录并存储每位会议参与者的独特声音特征（即'声纹'）……包括从未创建Fireflies账户、从未同意其服务条款、也从未给予书面同意的人员。"

该诉讼指控违反了伊利诺伊州生物信息隐私法（BIPA）
(opens in new tab)
：
未经同意收集生物识别语音数据
未发布数据保留或销毁政策

用户报告称即使删除账户后，机器人仍继续加入会议
(opens in new tab)
查普曼大学禁止Read AI（2025年8月）

学术机构也在采取行动。2025年8月，查普曼大学信息系统部门发布了安全通知
(opens in new tab)
：
"经过调查，由于安全、隐私和机构数据风险，禁止使用Read AI。"
该大学列举了以下担忧：
免费AI工具存在安全漏洞
这并非个案。医疗、教育和政府等各行业的组织正越来越多地限制基于云端的会议AI。
为什么云端会议AI存在隐私风险
children.id: 为什么云端会议ai存在隐私风险

children.text: 上述诉讼并非偶然--它们反映了云端会议工具处理数据方式的系统性问题。

大多数云端会议工具使用您的转录内容来改进其模型。来自Otter.ai自己的文档
(opens in new tab)

children.text: 根据法律环境和合规要求，以下组织应该对基于云端的会议转录三思：

会议录音通常包含受保护的健康信息（PHI）。虽然Otter.ai在2025年7月实现了HIPAA合规
(opens in new tab)
，Fireflies推出了"Fireflies for Healthcare"
(opens in new tab)
，但这些都需要：
企业计划（每用户每月25-35美元以上）
本地处理完全消除了第三方风险--当PHI从不离开您的设备时，不需要BAA。
律师事务所（特权保护问题）
children.id: 律师事务所特权保护问题

children.text:

(opens in new tab)

"允许笔记记录供应商访问或为自己目的使用转录内容，可能会为放弃特权提供依据，这在发生法律纠纷时会成为问题。"
金融法规要求严格的数据控制。GSC数据显示有关"ai会议助手数据安全金融"和"ai会议助手金融法规"的积极搜索。
云端工具带来的审计复杂性是本地处理可以避免的。

继查普曼大学之后，许多机构正在实施AI工具审查流程
(opens in new tab)
。云端会议AI通常无法通过这些审查。

Fireflies在美国服务器上处理数据
(opens in new tab)

(opens in new tab)
对离开欧盟的数据提供充分保护--美国云服务在这方面面临持续的法律不确定性。
GDPR提示：同意并非总是足够

即使获得同意，GDPR的数据最小化原则
(opens in new tab)
可能与记录、存储和分析一切的会议AI相冲突。具有用户控制保留期的本地处理是最安全的方法。
在选择会议助手之前，请问以下问题：
最佳： 留在您的设备上（本地处理）
可接受： 您公司的云端（自托管）
有风险： 供应商的云服务器
可见的会议机器人造成摩擦，并经常引发当前诉讼核心的同意问题。无机器人选项：
Meetily - 本地捕获系统音频
Granola - Mac原生，无机器人（但云端处理）
平台原生 - Zoom AI、Microsoft Copilot（无外部机器人）

能否未经明确批准就自动加入？
当有人说"不要录制"时会发生什么？
开源工具让您可以准确验证数据的处理方式。专有工具需要信任。

(opens in new tab)
缺乏已发布的保留/销毁政策是BIPA违规行为。
如果上述风险让您担忧，本地AI处理从架构上解决了这些问题--不是通过政策承诺，而是通过技术设计。

完全GDPR/HIPAA合规（无第三方处理者）
Meetily是免费、开源的，所有处理都在您的设备上完成。无云端、无机器人、无妥协。
无论您选择云端还是本地，请遵循以下指南：
创建批准工具列表 - 不要让员工随意安装会议AI
审查隐私政策 - 特别是数据训练和保留条款
建立同意协议 - 如何通知参与者？

考虑司法管辖区 - 12个州需要所有方同意
(opens in new tab)
定期审计 - 哪些AI工具有日历访问权限？
阅读隐私政策 - 特别是AI训练部分
检查自动加入设置 - 如果可能，请禁用
宣布录制 - 即使工具没有
审查数据保留 - 删除不需要的录音
考虑本地选项 - 用于敏感对话
始终披露AI录制 - 法律和道德要求
提供为敏感话题关闭的选项 - 建立信任
不要依赖机器人检测 - 有些工具不会明显显示机器人
获得明确同意 - 在某些州，口头同意是不够的
这取决于工具。基于云端的AI会议助手如Otter.ai、Fireflies和Read AI因隐私问题面临诉讼和机构禁令。像Meetily这样在您设备上处理数据的本地AI工具从架构上更安全，因为您的数据从不离开您的控制。
Otter.ai目前面临集体诉讼（Brewer诉Otter.ai，2025年8月），指控未经同意录制并未经许可使用数据训练AI。Otter拥有SOC 2认证，并于2025年7月实现HIPAA合规，但其同意模式--机器人自动加入并仅寻求主持人同意--在所有方同意州仍存在法律争议。
Fireflies.ai面临2025年12月的诉讼，指控其根据伊利诺伊州BIPA非法收集生物识别数据。用户报告称即使删除账户后机器人仍继续加入会议。该工具在云服务器上处理所有数据，如果Fireflies被攻破，会造成数据暴露。
查普曼大学于2025年8月禁止Read AI，理由是安全、隐私和机构数据风险。该工具存在令人担忧的行为，如自动加入会议和跨平台跟踪用户。大学必须根据FERPA和机构政策保护学生数据，而云端AI工具通常违反这些政策。
什么是最安全的AI会议助手？
最安全的AI会议助手使用本地处理，这意味着数据从不离开您的设备。Meetily是领先的选择--它是开源的（MIT许可证）、无机器人、离线工作，并将所有数据保留在您的机器上。对于云端工具，平台原生选项（Microsoft Copilot、Zoom AI）避免了第三方数据暴露，但仍使用云处理。
AI会议工具是否违反窃听法？
可能。美国有12个州在录制前需要所有方同意：加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、伊利诺伊州、马里兰州、马萨诸塞州、密歇根州、蒙大拿州、新罕布什尔州、宾夕法尼亚州、华盛顿州、特拉华州和康涅狄格州。自动加入并仅寻求主持人同意的云端会议工具可能违反这些法律--这正是Otter.ai诉讼案所指控的。
我的雇主可以在不告知我的情况下用AI录制会议吗？
这取决于州法律和公司政策。在单方同意州，如果雇主参与会议，他们可以录制。在双方同意州，必须通知所有参与者。无论哪种方式，大多数工作场所政策都要求披露。AI会议工具应该宣布其存在--但并非所有工具都能清楚地做到这一点。
如何在AI录制的会议中保护我的隐私？
询问会议是否正在被录制以及使用什么工具。要求为敏感话题关闭录制。在敏感行业，倡导使用不会将数据上传到第三方的本地AI工具。审查您组织的批准工具列表--影子AI是主要的泄露风险。

children.text: Son Seguros los Asistentes IA para Reuniones? Riesgos Expuestos (2026)

Demanda de Otter.ai, problemas de Fireflies, prohibiciones de Read AI - la IA de reuniones en la nube tiene riesgos reales. Comparamos alternativas seguras. Prueba Meetily gratis - 100% local, sin subidas a la nube.

children.alt: Meetily Security Team
Ilustracion sobre riesgos de privacidad y seguridad de asistentes de reuniones con IA

children.text:
Son seguros los asistentes de reuniones con IA? No todos. En 2025, Otter.ai enfrento una demanda colectiva
(opens in new tab)
 por grabar sin consentimiento, Fireflies.ai fue demandada por recopilacion de datos biometricos
(opens in new tab)
, y Chapman University prohibio Read AI
(opens in new tab)
 por preocupaciones de seguridad. Las herramientas de reuniones en la nube representan riesgos reales de privacidad: datos almacenados en servidores de terceros, IA entrenandose con tus conversaciones y grabaciones sin el consentimiento adecuado. Para una transcripcion de reuniones verdaderamente segura, el procesamiento local (como Meetily) mantiene tus datos en tu dispositivo.

Mas del 62% de las organizaciones
(opens in new tab)
 ahora usan asistentes de reuniones con IA. El mercado ha explotado hasta alcanzar $3.5 mil millones en 2025
(opens in new tab)
 y se proyecta que llegara a $34 mil millones para 2035.
Pero a medida que crece la adopcion, tambien lo hacen las demandas, las prohibiciones universitarias y los escandalos de privacidad.
Si estas usando IA de reuniones basada en la nube, necesitas entender los riesgos. Y si estas evaluando opciones, esta guia te ayudara a separar las herramientas seguras de las problematicas.
La Llamada de Atencion: Las Demandas de Asistentes de Reuniones con IA de 2025

En agosto de 2025, Justin Brewer presento una demanda colectiva
(opens in new tab)
 contra Otter.ai en un tribunal federal de California. Las acusaciones son graves:

"El servicio de transcripcion con IA de la empresa... por defecto no pide permiso a los participantes de la reunion para grabar y no advierte a los participantes que las grabaciones se comparten con Otter para mejorar sus sistemas de inteligencia artificial."

Acusaciones clave de la demanda
(opens in new tab)
:
El "OtterPilot" de Otter se une automaticamente a las reuniones sin consentimiento de todos los participantes
Los datos de las reuniones se usan para entrenar los modelos de IA de Otter sin permiso explicito
El servicio delega las obligaciones de consentimiento a los clientes en lugar de obtenerlo directamente

Violaciones de la Ley de Privacidad de Comunicaciones Electronicas (ECPA)
(opens in new tab)
, la Ley de Fraude y Abuso Informatico (CFAA)
(opens in new tab)
, y la Ley de Invasion de Privacidad de California (CIPA)
(opens in new tab)

El caso (Brewer v. Otter.ai Inc., Caso No. 5:25-cv-06911) todavia esta pendiente, con la fecha limite de respuesta de Otter extendida hasta noviembre de 2025
(opens in new tab)
.
California Es un Estado de Consentimiento de Dos Partes

La ley de California requiere el consentimiento de TODAS las partes
(opens in new tab)
 antes de grabar una conversacion. El enfoque de Otter de buscar consentimiento solo del anfitrion de la reunion, no de todos los participantes, entra en conflicto directo con este requisito.

Solo meses despues, Fireflies.ai enfrento su propio desafio legal
(opens in new tab)
. La residente de Illinois Katelin Cruz presento una demanda alegando:

"El asistente de reuniones de Fireflies.AI graba, analiza, transcribe y almacena las caracteristicas vocales unicas (es decir, 'huellas vocales') de cada participante de la reunion... incluyendo personas que nunca crearon una cuenta en Fireflies, nunca aceptaron sus terminos de servicio y nunca dieron consentimiento por escrito."

La demanda alega violaciones de la Ley de Privacidad de Informacion Biometrica de Illinois (BIPA)
(opens in new tab)
:
Recopilacion de datos biometricos de voz sin consentimiento
Sin politica publicada sobre retencion o destruccion de datos

Los usuarios reportan que el bot sigue uniendose a las reuniones incluso despues de eliminar su cuenta
(opens in new tab)

Las instituciones academicas tambien estan tomando medidas. En agosto de 2025, el departamento de Sistemas de Informacion de Chapman University emitio un aviso de seguridad
(opens in new tab)
:
"Despues de una investigacion, el uso de Read AI esta prohibido debido a riesgos de seguridad, privacidad y datos institucionales."
Datos que salen del control institucional
Falta de proteccion de datos adecuada
Vulnerabilidades de seguridad en herramientas de IA gratuitas
Esta no fue una decision aislada. Organizaciones en sectores de salud, educacion y gobierno estan restringiendo cada vez mas la IA de reuniones basada en la nube.
Por Que la IA de Reuniones en la Nube Representa Riesgos de Privacidad
Las demandas anteriores no son aleatorias: reflejan problemas sistemicos en como las herramientas de reuniones en la nube manejan tus datos.

La mayoria de las herramientas de reuniones en la nube usan tus transcripciones para mejorar sus modelos. De la propia documentacion de Otter.ai
(opens in new tab)
:
"Otter utiliza un metodo propietario para anonimizar los datos de usuario antes de entrenar nuestros modelos."

Incluso los datos "anonimizados" crean riesgos. La demanda contra Otter.ai alega
(opens in new tab)
 que los participantes no fueron informados de que sus conversaciones entrenarian la IA, una violacion significativa del consentimiento.
2. Datos Almacenados en Servidores de Terceros
Cuando usas IA de reuniones en la nube, tus grabaciones viven en servidores de otra persona:

El 29% de las filtraciones de IA provienen de plataformas SaaS de terceros

 que aquellas con controles

De quejas de usuarios sobre Fireflies

"Por defecto, Fireflies se une a cada evento del calendario y comparte las notas de la reunion con todos los asistentes... Tratar de silenciarlo o apagarlo es como intentar quitarse una garrapata de la pierna."

Esto no es solo molesto: potencialmente viola las leyes de escuchas telefonicas en 12 estados que requieren consentimiento de todas las partes

(opens in new tab)

La IA de reuniones es particularmente vulnerable porque:
Los empleados instalan extensiones de navegador sin supervision
Las integraciones de calendario se activan automaticamente
TI puede no saber que reuniones se estan grabando

children.text: Quien Deberia Evitar la IA de Reuniones en la Nube?
Basandose en el panorama legal y los requisitos de cumplimiento, estas organizaciones deberian pensarlo dos veces antes de usar transcripcion de reuniones basada en la nube:

Las grabaciones de reuniones a menudo contienen Informacion de Salud Protegida (PHI). Aunque Otter.ai logro el cumplimiento de HIPAA en julio de 2025
(opens in new tab)
 y Fireflies lanzo "Fireflies for Healthcare"
(opens in new tab)
, estos requieren:
Confianza en el manejo de datos de terceros
El procesamiento local elimina completamente el riesgo de terceros: no se necesita BAA cuando la PHI nunca sale de tu dispositivo.

Los expertos legales advierten
(opens in new tab)
 que permitir que los proveedores de IA de reuniones accedan a las transcripciones podria renunciar al privilegio abogado-cliente:

"Permitir que los proveedores de toma de notas accedan o usen las transcripciones para sus propios propositos podria proporcionar motivos para una renuncia al privilegio, lo cual es problematico en caso de una disputa legal."

Las regulaciones financieras requieren controles estrictos de datos. Los datos de GSC muestran busquedas activas de "seguridad de datos asistentes ia reuniones financieros" y "asistente ia reuniones regulaciones financieras."
Las herramientas en la nube crean complejidad de auditoria que el procesamiento local evita.

Siguiendo el ejemplo de Chapman University, muchas instituciones estan implementando procesos de revision de herramientas de IA
(opens in new tab)
. La IA de reuniones en la nube a menudo no pasa estas revisiones.

Fireflies procesa datos en servidores de EE.UU.
(opens in new tab)
, creando problemas de transferencia de GDPR. El GDPR requiere
(opens in new tab)
 proteccion adecuada para los datos que salen de la UE: los servicios en la nube de EE.UU. enfrentan incertidumbre legal continua aqui.
Consejo GDPR: El Consentimiento No Siempre Es Suficiente

Incluso con consentimiento, el principio de minimizacion de datos
(opens in new tab)
 del GDPR puede entrar en conflicto con la IA de reuniones que graba, almacena y analiza todo. El procesamiento local con retencion controlada por el usuario es el enfoque mas seguro.
Como Evaluar la Seguridad de la IA de Reuniones
Antes de elegir un asistente de reuniones, haz estas preguntas:
Mejor: Permanecen en tu dispositivo (procesamiento local)
Aceptable: La nube de tu empresa (auto-alojado)
Arriesgado: Servidores en la nube del proveedor
Los bots de reunion visibles crean friccion y a menudo desencadenan los problemas de consentimiento en el centro de las demandas actuales. Opciones sin bot:
Meetily - Captura audio del sistema localmente
Granola - Nativo de Mac, sin bot (pero procesamiento en la nube)
Nativo de plataforma - Zoom AI, Microsoft Copilot (sin bot externo)

Requiere consentimiento de TODOS los participantes?
Puede unirse automaticamente sin aprobacion explicita?
Que pasa cuando alguien dice "no grabar"?
Las herramientas de codigo abierto te permiten verificar exactamente que pasa con tus datos. Las herramientas propietarias requieren confianza.
5. Cual Es la Politica de Retencion de Datos?

La demanda contra Fireflies especificamente cita
(opens in new tab)
 la falta de politicas publicadas de retencion/destruccion como una violacion de BIPA.
Si los riesgos anteriores te preocupan, el procesamiento local de IA los resuelve arquitectonicamente, no a traves de promesas de politicas, sino a traves de diseno tecnico.
Como funciona la IA de reuniones local:

Los resumenes se generan localmente (o con tu API elegida)
Todos los datos permanecen en tu maquina
Lo que esto significa para la privacidad:
Ninguna filtracion de servidor puede exponer tus reuniones (los datos no estan alli)
Sin ambiguedad de consentimiento (tu controlas la grabacion)
Sin entrenamiento de IA en tus conversaciones (los datos nunca salen)
Cumplimiento completo de GDPR/HIPAA (sin procesadores de terceros)

Ya sea que elijas nube o local, sigue estas pautas:
